description: To control tax hikes and manage spending, I proposed HJR1005,the "Arkansas Taxpayer Bill of Rights" Amendment. This amendment mandates a3/4 majority vote in both houses to raise any tax or fee and requires a balanced budget.It limits the growth of state government spending by capping budget increases to the rate of inflation and mandates that budget surpluses be refunded to taxpayers.I will not vote for any tax increases on the citizens of Arkansas!
